channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Bank strike today: Why are unions holding nationwide protest, what are their demands | Explained
item.description: Bank strike today: Lakhs of bank employees held a nationwide strike on Friday, bringing operations at thousands of branches across India to a halt. Why are bank unions holding protest and what are tehir demands? Here, we explain.

item.title: Mint explainer: what is the new PACT under Niti Aayog’s e-truck plan?
item.description: India is pushing to electrify its truck fleet, but high vehicle costs, limited charging infrastructure and weak demand have slowed adoption. Mint explains how Niti Aayog’s new PACT aims to bridge these gaps.

item.title: IRCTC case: Judge frames money laundering charges against Lalu, 8 others, quotes Tagore – what happened in Delhi Court
item.description: The Judge said Tagore held the moral compass for the Indian freedom movement and his words often bestowed cohesion in times of prevarication among the balladeers of freedom.

item.title: ChatGPT prompt for photo editing: Want Kerala-style retro images from 1960s, 70s, 80s and 90s? Try these five ideas
item.description: The viral ChatGPT retro photo trend is moving beyond generic 1980s portraits. Here are five prompts that can help users recreate Kerala-inspired photographs from the 1960s, 1970s, 1980s and 1990s, with period-specific clothing, hairstyles, jewellery, homes and analogue photography effects.

item.title: ‘It’s a murder done by the system': CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke on MPSC aspirant Prathamesh Deshmukh's suicide
item.description: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke called MPSC aspirant Prathamesh Deshmukh's suicide a murder by the system, blaming unemployment, financial stress, paper leaks and delayed results. He also said the CJP will join the agitation by MPSC aspirants.

item.title: BRICS Summit: AAI announces airspace restrictions; non-scheduled flights barred from 11-13 Sept at Delhi's IGI airport
item.description: Delhi is gearing up for the 18th BRICS Summit on 12-13 September, with airspace, rail and road restrictions announced across the capital. More than 30 special flights are expected, while train services and traffic movement will also face changes during the summit.

item.title: IB flags China, Russia-linked protests; security tightened across Delhi ahead of BRICS Summit: Report
item.description: The Delhi Police and central security agencies have stepped up vigilance in the national capital ahead of the upcoming BRICS Summit following Intelligence Bureau alerts about possible attempts to disrupt VVIP movement, breach security arrangements and create disturbances, top IB sources said.

item.title: Delhi steps up security for Xi Jinping's arrival after Putin lands: Fortified hotels, motorcades and more
item.description: Delhi has stepped up security for Chinese President Xi Jinping's arrival for the BRICS summit after Russian President Vladimir Putin landed in the capital. Fortified hotels, multi-layered security, route rehearsals and traffic curbs are in place for the leaders and their motorcades.

item.title: 1980s AI photo trend on ChatGPT: Mistakes to avoid for realistic retro photos on Instagram, WhatsApp
item.description: The viral 1980s AI photo trend is turning selfies into grainy, retro-style portraits using ChatGPT. From vague prompts to modern backgrounds and altered facial features, here are common mistakes to avoid when creating vintage-looking images for Instagram and WhatsApp.

item.title: Delhi school holiday today: Schools shut on September 11 ahead of BRICS Summit
item.description: Schools across Delhi are closed today, September 11, as authorities step up security and traffic arrangements ahead of the 18th BRICS Leaders’ Summit. The holiday covers government, government-aided and recognised unaided private schools under the Delhi Directorate of Education.

item.title: US-Canada trade war: Carney expects new tariffs to hurt some businesses, but Ottawa unlikely to retaliate
item.description: Days after the US announced new trade measures against Canada, Prime Minister Mark Carney on Thursday said that his government is not planning to retaliate and is instead focusing on strengthening the domestic economy.&nbsp;

item.title: BRICS 2026 Delhi traffic advisory: Roads to avoid today, best routes to airport, railway stations by buses, metro, taxis
item.description: BRICS Summit 2026, New Delhi traffic advisory: Here are details about which routes to avoid on Friday, diversion points and alternative routes to follow.

item.title: Petrol and diesel prices today – 11 Sep: Fuel rates in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru as Crude oil extends rally
item.description: Petrol and diesel prices today – 11 Sep: Check fuel rates in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru and other cities as crude oil extended rally amid renewed Houthis attacks on Saudi oil facilities and recovery in Chinese oil demand.

item.title: Ebola Reaches Congo’s Sud-Ubangi Province After Patient Traveled Through Rwanda and Uganda
item.description: Ebola has now spread to a seventh province in the Democratic Republic of Congo after a 23-year-old man tested positive for the virus following a cross-country journey that included travel through neighboring Rwanda and Uganda.

item.title: Another choke point for oil? Iran-backed Houthis seize Yemen port of Mocha, threaten Red Sea shipping
item.description: The Houthis' gaining control of Mocha gave them “a direct presence on the approaches to one of the world’s most vital straits,” raising serious concerns about freedom of navigation, UN Special Envoy for Yemen Hans Grundberg said.

item.title: Iran war news LIVE: Shipping traffic in the Strait of Hormuz hovers in single digits as tensions escalate, shows data
item.description: Iran war news LIVE: Vessel transits at the Strait of Hormuz fell to seven on Thursday from 11 the previous day, preliminary ship tracking data showed on Friday, well below the 10-day average of 15.

item.title: BRICS Summit security: 15,000 personnel, 200 CAPF companies, 100 NSG commandos deployed in Delhi
item.description: Ahead of the BRICS Summit, Delhi Police has put in place an extensive security and traffic management plan, with more than 15,000 personnel mobilised and around 200 companies of Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF) deployed for law-and-order and other operational duties.

item.title: Jimmy Kimmel moves James Talarico interview to YouTube, says FCC pressure kept it off ABC television
item.description: Jimmy Kimmel said his interview with Texas Democratic Senate candidate James Talarico will not air on ABC and will instead be released on YouTube. The late night show host accused Trump-led FCC of pressuring the network over its handling of political candidates.

item.title: BRICS Summit 2026: Delhi airspace curbs tighten as flight restrictions begin – What it means for IGI passengers
item.description: Special airspace security measures are set to take effect around Delhi for the BRICS Summit. Scheduled commercial flights will continue, but restrictions will apply to other aircraft, smaller flying activities and certain airports and helipads.

item.title: BRICS 2026: Delhi braces for traffic diversions from 2 pm to 8:30 pm tomorrow, check alternate routes, diversion points
item.description: Delhi will see traffic diversions and restrictions from 2 pm to 8:30 pm on Friday as the BRICS Summit begins. More than 35 roads and 22 diversion points are part of the traffic plan, with alternate routes issued for the airport and railway stations.

item.title: H-1B visa issue: Trump administration proposes scrapping 60-day grace period, Indian techies to be affected
item.description: Under the proposed rule, H-1B and holders of certain other temporary work visas would have to leave the United States as soon as their employment ends. The move is expected to disrupt major US technology companies.

item.title: Senator John Fetterman sparks Democratic Party backlash after appearance at Republican midterm convention
item.description: Fetterman delivered the approximately one-minute address virtually while standing outside a major steel-processing facility in Pittsburgh

item.title: Did Adani Group begin preliminary assessment to renovate Writers’ Building in Kolkata? Project could cost up to ₹120 cr
item.description: Reportedly, Adani Group is leading the restoration and renovation work of Writers' Building in Kolkata. According to sources, Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari had asked the Group to take on the project.

item.title: NSO survey shows a tiny bunch of districts with a chunk of informal economy
item.description: According the survey, the scale of the unincorporated sector varies sharply across districts. Roughly one-third of the districts have more than one lakh unincorporated establishments each, while about 9% have fewer than 10,000 establishments.

item.title: Oil crosses $105 a barrel as West Asia hostilities escalate
item.description: Yemen’s Houthi militia has captured the critical Red Sea city of Mocha, widening its hold over the strategic Bab-al-Mandeb strait, a vital global trade corridor, according to a report by Al Jazeera.

item.title: Goyal calls for push to boost India-Russia trade to $100 billion by 2030
item.description: Speaking at an event with Russian minister of industry and trade Anton Alikhanov in New Delhi, Goyal said bilateral trade, currently at around $60 billion a year, would need to grow by another $40 billion over the next four years, requiring sustained double-digit annual growth.

item.title: Matcha vs coffee: India grows more curious about 800-year-old Japanese drink; Google searches surge up to 2,500%
item.description: India's beverage preferences are expanding, with growing interest in matcha, ube, and hojicha. Searches indicate a desire for new flavours and preparation methods.

item.title: Walmart recalls Great Value Organic Triple Berry Blend over potential E. coli contamination: What consumers should know
item.description: Frutas y Hortalizas del Sur S.A. recalls Great Value Frozen Organic Triple Berry Blend due to possible E. coli O145 contamination. The 10-oz product was sold in select Walmart stores across 16 states. Consumers should check their freezers and return the product for a refund, it said.
